title: feat(studio): a Chinese display name derives its identifier by pinyin at every Studio create door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbJWK4KPmYk5DcrJTSxbJRJk)_

Fixes #29690

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim: [6593397218](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29690#issuecomment-6593397218) · amendments [6593439786](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29690#issuecomment-6593439786), [6593495761](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/29690#issuecomment-6593495761)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 里所有“由名称生成标识”的新建入口（新建软件包、新建对象等、添加字段、通用新建表单、新建视图、对象/报表/数据集设计器的 Name、字段 API 名、选项值），中文名称现在按词转成不带声调的拼音再生成标识：`维修中心` → `weixiu_zhongxin`，`客户等级` → `kehu_dengji`。生成的标识照常显示、可改。
- **为什么改**：中文管理员用中文起名，过去每个入口都停下来要求手填英文标识，上手头十分钟要被拦好几次。
- **风险与回滚**：拼音字典 `pinyin-pro` 是按需加载的独立分包，首次遇到汉字才下载；加载失败时退回原来的“无法生成，请手填”。常驻包只多 0.9 KB（预算内）。回滚即还原本 PR，无数据迁移。
- **先看**：`romanizeHan.ts`（共享规则与加载状态）；`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 两行（添加字段预览名与实际创建名一致）；`PackageFormDialog.tsx`（软件包 ID 与命名空间）。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/romanizeHan.test.ts`，预期 9 条全绿（含多音字 `银行`→`yinhang`、`行动`→`xingdong`）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One shared derivation, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/romanizeHan.ts`, sits in front of each door's existing sanitizer. Latin text is untouched; each Chinese word becomes its toneless pinyin, then the door applies the rule it always applied (`toFieldNameLoose`, `toFieldNameOrEmpty`, `slugify`, or the package id's `toIdSegment`). So the namespace prefix, the `__c` suffix of a customization pair and the taken-name hint are unchanged; they now see `weixiu_zhongxin` where they used to see an empty string.

- **Doors.** New package (`com.<org>.weixiu-zhongxin`, namespace `weixiu_zhongxin`); the new-item dialog; Add field, where the popover's preview and the host's created name both go through the helper, so the name previewed is the name created; the generic create form (`createDerive.ts`); New view; the object, report and dataset designers' Name; a fresh field's API name in the field inspector; and a picklist option's value. That last one was a silent loss: a Chinese option label derived an empty value and the row was never saved.
- **Words, not syllables.** Word boundaries come from `Intl.Segmenter('zh', { granularity: 'word' })`, and `pinyin-pro` reads a polyphone by its word (`银行` → `yinhang`, `行动` → `xingdong`). `ü` is written `v` (`绿色` → `lvse`). Without `Intl.Segmenter`, each character's reading is joined by `_` (`ke_hu_deng_ji`).
- **Loading.** The dictionary is fetched the first time a door sees a Han character. Until it lands, the door keeps the identifier empty, keeps Create off, and holds back its "not derived" line (`romanizerPending`). When it lands, a door whose identifier still follows the name fills it in without another keystroke (`useHanRomanizer` / `useWhenRomanizerLands`). The fill runs once, on the render where the dictionary landed, so a person who clears the identifier to type their own is never refilled. If the chunk cannot be fetched, the load settles as failed, one `console.warn` says so, and every door falls back to its "not derived" line and a hand-typed identifier, as before this PR.
- **Japanese.** Text containing kana is left alone, so a Japanese name still asks for the identifier. The existing pins that asserted "a Chinese name derives nothing" now assert the same invariant with a kana sample.
- **Package dialog subtitle.** The subtitle says "Give it a name to start; everything else is filled in for you." That promise now holds for a Chinese name. It still does not hold for a Japanese one, which opens the advanced section with the hint, as before. The copy is unchanged.

**Bundle choice.** The client derives the pinyin itself, from `pinyin-pro` loaded as a lazy chunk. It is the library the server's pinyin search plugin already uses and is already in the lockfile, and it reads polyphones by word. I rejected a server route because it would add a REST route for a create-time preview, and `plugin-pinyin-search` runs only behind `OS_SEARCH_PINYIN_ENABLED`. I rejected the collator-sort libraries because they read polyphones wrong.

`pnpm --dir ui check:eager-closure`:

| | eager closure (gz) | eager chunks |
|:--|--:|--:|
| base `1c1a5d40` | 2092.9 KB | 100 of 2397 |
| this branch before the main merge | 2093.8 KB | 101 of 2399 |
| final head (after merging main) | 2094.3 KB | 101 of 2399 |

The last row's extra 0.5 KB is main's own change in `vendor-objectstack`, which went from 573.1 to 573.6 KB. The ceiling and baseline are untouched, and headroom is 337.3 KB. The dictionary chunk is `assets/esm-Cst8rBvH.js`: 286.6 KB raw, 141.7 KB gzipped, and lazy. The helper itself, about 0.9 KB, is in the eager closure because `PackageFormDialog` is eager. The seat accepted this on the card thread.

## Tests

New:

- `romanizeHan.test.ts`
  - Before load: text unchanged and pending.
  - After load: `weixiu_zhongxin` and `kehu_dengji` through every door sanitizer, plus the polyphone pair, `lvse`, mixed `维修Center 2号` → `weixiu_center_2_hao`, and kana unchanged.
  - With `Intl.Segmenter` absent: `ke_hu_deng_ji` and `yin_hang`.
- `romanizeHan.loadFailure.test.tsx`
  - The chunk import rejects, the load settles, nothing is pending, and one warning is logged.
  - `CreateItemDialog` shows its "not derived" line, and a hand-typed id submits.
- `romanizeHan.lands-29690.test.tsx`
  - `CreateItemDialog` stays empty and quiet with Create off while loading, then shows `weixiu_zhongxin` with Create on.
- `createDerive.romanizerLands-29690.test.tsx`
  - The generic create form is pending, then `kehu_dengji` with nothing underivable.
- `ReportDefaultInspector.romanizerLands-29690.test.tsx`
  - The designer Name fills on landing.
  - A cleared Name is not refilled.
- `CreateViewDialog.pinyinName-29690.test.tsx`
  - `客户列表` → `kehu_liebiao`, and the name is editable.
  - A kana label derives nothing.

Extended with a zh-CN case each:

- `CreateItemDialog.notDerived-13389`: the namespace prefix gives `repairs_weixiu_zhongxin`.
- `PackageFormDialog.idDerive-11792`: org `acme` gives `com.acme.weixiu-zhongxin` and namespace `weixiu_zhongxin` in the posted manifest; the id stays editable.
- `DataPillar.addFieldPopover-12516`: the preview `kehu_dengji` equals the created field; a second `客户等级` gets the taken-name hint.
- `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575`: the preview `kehu_dengji__c` equals the extension field saved.
- `ResourceEditPage.underivableName-28232`
- `Report…`/`DatasetDefaultInspector.labelLeavesNameEmpty-12789`
- `ObjectDefaultInspector`
- `ObjectFieldInspector.apiNameSync`
- `ObjectFieldInspector.optionLabelFirst-27521`: `进行中`/`已完成` → `jinxing_zhong`/`yi_wancheng` saved, and the field parses.

Kana samples replace the Chinese ones in `PackageFormDialog.derivedFields-12512`, `PackageFormDialog.nameOnlyFirstStep-27833` and `ResourceEditPage.identifierIssueI18n-28369`.

Ablations went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each one went red and was restored to HEAD:

| mutation | result |
|:--|:--|
| `romanizeHan` returns its input | 8 of 16 red |
| the Add-field host derives without pinyin | 2 of 12 red, preview ≠ created |
| the landing fill runs every render | 2 of 7 red, a cleared Name is refilled |

## Acceptance notes

- A fresh field's API name in the field inspector derives on the label keystroke after the dictionary has landed. It does not re-derive on landing by itself: the inspector returns early before its row exists. In practice the dictionary has already landed by then, because a field is created through Add field, which loads it.
- Add field keeps parity with a Latin label. The derived name is shown as the popover's preview, and the person edits it in the field inspector after creating, as today.
- No zh/en catalogue rows changed. Every door's existing "not derived" sentence still applies, and only to text the rule cannot read.

## Verification

All runs were under `os-verify-lock`.

<details><summary>Affected tests, type-check, lint</summary>

- `turbo`-affected app-shell test files: 308 files in 6 batches.
  - The first run's reds were all pins asserting that a Chinese name derives nothing, plus one real bug, the designer Name refilling after it was cleared. Both are fixed above.
  - The new and changed files re-ran 35 of 35 green (259 tests). The field inspector files re-ran 31 of 31 green (324 tests).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65 of 65 tasks pass.
- `eslint` on the changed files: 0 errors.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 57 commands on this diff, and `--ran` reconciled all 57. 56 exit 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3, because it needs every workspace package built; it is left to CI. The exit codes are in the os-dev report on the card.

</details>
